jd_insights.summary: Meta seeks entry-level software engineers to join its Bangalore team, focusing on building and improving global-scale products (e.g., mobile/web apps, AR/VR). The role involves solving complex technical challenges, writing high-quality code, and contributing to systems that connect billions of users, with opportunities to grow into increasingly complex projects.
required_skills: adherence to development standards (from coding to release)
software engineering experience (internships, work, competitions, or publications)
writing high-quality code with test coverage

knowledge_requirements.text: Develop a strong understanding of relevant product area, codebase, and/or systems
Master Meta’s development standards from developing to releasing code in order to take on tasks and projects with increasing levels of complexity

knowledge_mentions.excerpt: Domain exposure includes **payments, fraud detection, ETL, and real-time systems**.
Designed scalable microservices with **concurrency control** (e.g., Redis-backed order-matching engine).
Optimized ML inference pipelines for **production throughput**, including model batching and latency trade-offs.
Implemented **CI/CD automation** (Jenkins + AWS CodePipeline) for zero-downtime deployments.
Applied **code-splitting and lazy loading** in React to improve UX response times.
Developed **ETL parallelization strategies** using Airflow to reduce runtime bottlenecks.
Integrated **OAuth2/JWT** for secure authentication in full-stack applications.
Built **real-time systems** with low-latency requirements (e.g., order-matching engine).

quantification_suggestions: Specify the **absolute latency values** before/after the 30% reduction (e.g., 'from 200ms to 140ms').
Clarify the **baseline throughput** for the ML fraud detection system (e.g., 'from 1000 to 2000 requests/sec').
Define the **scale of the payments platform** (e.g., 'handling 10K transactions/day').
Quantify the **impact of React optimizations** (e.g., 'reduced bundle size by X% or improved FCP by Yms').
Add **team size or scope** for the Hackathon XYZ prototype (e.g., 'built in 48 hours with 3 teammates').
